items.topic: Peripheral nerve microanatomy: epineurium, perineurium, endoneurium, myelin and nodes of Ranvier
items.destination_intent: Hand 2026 peripheral nerve injury and repair teaching note when OITE logging is requested
items.teaching_point_placement: Adjacent to the nerve-layer function table and fascicle versus individual fiber distinction
items.caption_intent: Exact user-uploaded labeled peripheral nerve cross-section and longitudinal fiber schematic. C identifies epineurium around the whole nerve; D perineurium around a fascicle; E endoneurium around individual fiber units; B myelin; F a node of Ranvier; A a nerve fiber. Teaching distinguishes connective tissue architecture from electrical conduction and insulation.
